## Summary
- add bounded transient ReplayRequired checkpoints with deterministic forward-only reconstruction
- add scrub debounce plus generation-based cooperative cancellation
- add exact VFX transient checkpoint/restore and fixed-step forward replay
- retain lazy checkpoint fallback and BTreeMap entry insertion
- normalize the implementation to Rust 1.97.1 rustfmt output
- rebuild from current main after current-main affected-scope drift invalidated the earlier branch

## Validation
Run GameEngine Windows Validation for the affected scope. No Editor/Launcher presentation is changed, so Visual Validation is not required.
